verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a SaaS compliance product, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows rule-based registration-obligation monitoring ('insights about your potential tax registration obligations') and transaction reports, with nothing describing AI-generated insights or suggestions. The official MCP server exposes Stripe to external agents. It is not an AI feature inside the product, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
